ios.desc:
Linux Journey (linuxjourney.com) is officially part of LabEx.

Linux Journey is a beginner-friendly Linux learning app designed to help you understand Linux through hands-on practice instead of passive videos.

Explore Linux fundamentals step by step with interactive lessons covering:

• Linux basics
• Shell commands
• File systems
• Permissions
• Processes
• Networking
• Bash scripting
• Package management
• System administration fundamentals

Built for beginners, Linux Journey focuses on learning by doing. Practice commands, read explanations, and build real Linux skills at your own pace.

Whether you're starting your DevOps, cybersecurity, cloud, or programming journey, Linux Journey provides a clean and approachable way to learn Linux anywhere.

Features:

• Beginner-friendly lessons
• Interactive command-line learning
• Structured learning paths
• Lightweight and distraction-free experience
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad
• Learn anytime, anywhere

Start your Linux journey today.

For Terms of Use, visit: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
